prerequisites: EM1012 - Mecànica de Màquines i Estructures
EM1015 - Ciència i Tecnologia de Materials
EM1019 - Elasticitat i Resistència de Materials
EM1020 - Teoria de Màquines i Mecanismes

learning_outcomes.text: Be able to solve problems of system behavior calculation, experimental identification, and controller design, analytically and with computer aid.
Be able to write a technical report on a work in the field of automatics that includes a calculation part and an experimental part.
Be able to identify a model of a continuous linear system from experimental data, using a computer.
Be able to model simple sequential systems and obtain the algorithm for their automatic control using a programmable device.
Be able to design a PID controller for a process, to meet the required operating specifications, analytically and by computer.
Be able to calculate the time evolution of continuous linear dynamic systems from their mathematical model and characterize their behavior in time and frequency, analytically and by computer.

syllabus_topics: Sequential control vs. continuous systems control
Concept of a continuous dynamic system
Basic concepts: control input, disturbances, output
Mathematical modeling of systems. Ordinary differential equations (ODEs)
Response of first and second order systems
Dominant poles and zeros of a linear system
Analysis of feedback systems. PID control
Tuning of PID controllers using frequency response
Frequency response of a linear system
Stability criteria based on frequency response
Control specifications based on frequency response
Design strategies for PID controllers using frequency response
Control of systems with pure delay. Smith predictor
Control with two degrees of freedom
Modeling and control of sequential processes
Tank level control using an industrial PID controller
Speed and position control of a DC motor
assessment_rules: Students pass if they obtain at least 5 out of 10 in the overall average grade. A minimum score of 4 out of 10 is required on the final exam to average other grades; if not met, the overall grade cannot exceed 4.5. Practical activities are not recoverable and if not submitted, score zero. In the second call, partial exams can be recovered as part of the final exam, which then counts for 80%.
